description: Deterministic duplicate and contradiction fixtures for propose-time review (api-go/internal/workspaceops memory_dedupe.go and memory_conflicts.go). No model runs: TestEval02DedupeConflictFixtures seeds each case's memories (served ones are approved by two peers), proposes the case's text (as a verifier when propose.reviewer is set, since only a reviewer is told about pending memory), and checks the result. expect.outcome is created or corroborated (duplicate_of names the seed restated); expect.duplicates and expect.conflicts map every seed the result names to its match (exact, near, similar) or conflict kind (claim, contradiction, path_overlap), and no other seed may appear; suggested_supersedes lists the seeds suggested, exactly. merge_into, when set, has two peers verify the proposal duplicate_of that seed; recall must then serve the seed and not the proposal. The service-port cases reuse the memories of eval/tasks/seed.yaml's service-agreed-port task.
